findingDetails.title: Packet completion status contradicts active phase records
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the parent status, phase map, goal checklist, and child phase metadata against current task state.
findingDetails.claim: The packet's progress records disagree and can misstate the phase completion state.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The goal and later phase records claim completion, but phase 2 still lists open tasks.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The fields may have been authored at different times or mean different types of completion, but the packet does not distinguish them.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if root Status is documentation-only and phase 2 open-task metadata is proven stale.

findingDetails.title: Staged type-change paths bypass the local-skill guard
findingDetails.recommendation: Make the staged-path scan include type changes, or otherwise inspect all changed index paths, and cover a tracked local-* path changing file type.
findingDetails.claim: The blocking hook filters staged paths to ACMR, which omits Git type-change status T; a local-* path changed from one file type to another is therefore not matched by the private-path guard.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The guard catches newly added, modified, copied, and renamed local-* paths, and current ignored roots are not normally tracked; the gap is limited to a type change at an already tracked local-* path.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: This remains P2 unless a reachable tracked local-* path is shown to carry private payload through the omitted T status, which would raise severity.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A staged local-* path with status T may be omitted from the path-name guard.
searchLedger.invariant: Every staged local-* skill path is rejected before commit regardless of Git change type.
